title: An unforgettable bike tour of Seville and exceptional monuments!
text: We had a magical time thanks to Victor, our guide who helped us discover Seville from its most beautiful angles. The bike ride was a real treat: the city is perfect for it and the pace was perfectly adapted. It is the ideal solution for exploring the picturesque neighborhoods without getting tired while enjoying Victor's fascinating explanations. Beyond the ride, discovering the city's jewels like the Alcazar, the majestic cathedral, and the ascent of the Giralda was a highlight. title: The best guide to Seville
text: A magnificent Sevilla experience with Victor who made us discover with passion the Alcazar, the Cathedral, the Jewish Quarter, the Spanish Steps, the Maria Luisa Park, and many more! Communicative enthusiasm, great culture, patience, kindness, and adaptability, it was a real pleasure. He was unanimous in our small family group. Thank you Victor!

author: Servane D

title: Seville Special Anniversary break
text:
We had two walking tours on successive days for 3 hours in the morning. Manual and Víctor were our guide. Manual took us to the Alcazar and the Jewish Quarter whilst Victor took us to the Plaza de Espana and the Cathedral
The tours included entrance tickets
Both Manual and Victor were very Knowledgeable and we learnt so much more than we could have done on our own or in a big group all in perfect English and with humour, coffee and comfort stops and finishing with recommendations to local tapas bars for lunch.
Perfect for the 4 of us
I can thoroughly recommend to compliment any Seville break
T
author: garyaP2459EZ

title: Seville with family and Victor
text:
Victor was a great guide! he knew how to adapt to our group (9 people from 13 to 78 years old!) and also change plans at the last moment following a problem with tickets for the Alcazar!
Smiling and funny.
He was also a help in preparing for our stay in Seville by advising me taxi artisans for our late transfer from the airport.
Anyway the next time I come back to Seville to better discover the place, I will appeal to Victor
Catherine and her family
